31340-the-colored-girl-beautiful.title: Beautiful
31340-the-colored-girl-beautiful.creator: Unknown
31340-the-colored-girl-beautiful.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Would you like to talk about Love--real Love?" "Yes, yes," came the answer. "Would you like to talk about Beauty--real Beauty?" "Yes! Yes!" they answered and the chairs were pulled forward. For forty minutes we had a heart to heart talk. The dean and teachers had perhaps told the girls the same words, but the message seemed to come more directly to them from one who had daily contact with the great, busy world.

39081-the-dorrance-domain.title: The Dorrance Domain
39081-the-dorrance-domain.creator: Unknown
39081-the-dorrance-domain.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "I don't mind the dinners," said Leicester, "in fact I would be rather sorry not to have them. What I mind is the cramped space, and the shut-up-in-your-own-room feeling. I spoke a piece in school last week, and I spoke it awful well, too, because I just meant it. It began, 'I want free life, and I want fresh air,' and that's exactly what I do want. I wish we lived in Texas, instead of on Manhattan Island.

arxiv-2106-00916.title: Grothendieck rings of definable subassignments and equivariant motivic measures Thanks: The first author’s research is funded by the Vietnam National University, Hanoi (VNU) under project number QG.19.06.
arxiv-2106-00916.creator: Lê Quy Thuong
arxiv-2106-00916.description: Abstract . The paper studies categories of definable subassignments with some category equivalences to semi-algebraic and constructible subsets of arc spaces of algebraic varieties. These materials allow us to compare the motivic measure of Cluckers-Loeser and the one of Denef-Loeser in certain classes of definable subassignments. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 03C10, 14E18, 14G10 1.

arxiv-2108-10061.title: An Extensible and Modular Design and Implementation of Monte Carlo Tree Search for the JVM
arxiv-2108-10061.creator: Larkin Liu larkin.liu@mail.utoronto.ca
arxiv-2108-10061.description: Abstract Flexible implementations of Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), combined with domain specific knowledge and hybridization with other search algorithms, can be very powerful for finding the solutions to problems in complex planning. We introduce mctreesearch4j , a MCTS implementation written as a standard JVM library following key design principles of object oriented programming.

arxiv-2212-07979.title: Improving Developers’ Understanding of Regex Denial of Service Tools through Anti-Patterns and Fix Strategies
arxiv-2212-07979.creator: Sk Adnan Hassan 1, Zainab Aamir, Dongyoon Lee, James C. Davis, Francisco Servant 2
arxiv-2212-07979.description: Abstract Regular expressions are used for diverse purposes, including input validation and firewalls. Unfortunately, they can also lead to a security vulnerability called ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service), caused by a super-linear worst-case execution time during regex matching. Due to the severity and prevalence of ReDoS, past work proposed automatic tools to detect and fix regexes.

arxiv-2306-14906.title: Developed Method. Interactions and their quantum picture.
arxiv-2306-14906.creator: Piotr Ogonowski
arxiv-2306-14906.description: Abstract By developing the previously proposed method of combining continuum mechanics with Einstein Field Equations, it has been shown that the classic relativistic description, curvilinear description, and quantum description of the physical system may be reconciled using the proposed Alena Tensor.

arxiv-2308-00123.title: On the distribution of the norm of partitions
arxiv-2308-00123.creator: Walter Bridges and William Craig
arxiv-2308-00123.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Walter Bridges and William Craig. The norm of an integer partition is defined as the product of its parts. This statistic was recently introduced by Schneider in connection to partition zeta functions. In this note, we use the method of moments to study the distribution of the norm under the uniform probability measure on partitions of n n as n → ∞ n\to\infty .

arxiv-2502-04332.title: Gravitational Deflection of Vector Photons via Effective Field Theory
arxiv-2502-04332.creator: Yihan Ma & Ding-fang Zeng
arxiv-2502-04332.description: Abstract Gravitational scattering of the electromagnetic field from a heavy scalar field provides a fundamental testbed for understanding the deflection of light by massive bodies. In many approaches based on effective field theory, the calculation of scattering amplitudes quickly becomes complicated due to the large number of Feynman integrals required, especially beyond leading order.

europmc-pmc6642117.description: The proliferation, differentiation and survival of mononuclear phagocytes depend on signals from the receptor for macrophage colony-stimulating factor, CSF1R. The mammalian Csf1r locus contains a highly conserved super-enhancer, the fms-intronic regulatory element (FIRE). Here...

pmc-10707106.title: Synthesis of Novel Phosphorus-Containing Derivatives of 1,3,4-Trimethylglycoluril via the Birum–Oleksyszyn Reaction
pmc-10707106.creator: Sergey I. Gorbin, Abdigali A. Bakibaev, Vera P. Tuguldurova, Andrey V. Kotov, Gleb O. Sysoev, Andrei S. Potapov, Dmitry I. Pavlov, Victor S. Malkov, Alexey S. Knyazev, Dmitriy A. Kurgachev, Mark V. Michalchenkov
pmc-10707106.description: This work presents the synthesis of a new compound, 1-[aryl-(diphenylphosphono)methyl]-3,4,6-trimethylglycolurils, via the interaction of benzaldehyde and its mononitro- and monohydroxyderivatives with 1,3,4-trimethylglycoluril and triphenylphosphite. By varying the reaction conditions and the catalysts, the obtained product yields ranged from satisfactory to good. The diastereomers formed during the reaction were separated by semipreparative HPLC on the C18 stationary phase.

pmc-11326461.title: Lymphovenous Bypass as an Alternative Strategy for Managing Phleboedema and Venous Leg Ulcers: Preliminary Results
pmc-11326461.creator: Sungchuan Chao, Chenhisang Kuan, Yingsheng Lin, Haochih Tai, Naichen Cheng
pmc-11326461.description: Background:Chronic venous leg ulcers (VLUs) are a common manifestation of chronic venous insufficiency, accounting for up to 70% of all chronic leg ulcers. Patients sustained refractory ulcers and persistent phleboedema even with a combination of different treatment methods. Lymphovenous bypass (LVB) has shown promising results in patients with lymphedema.

pmc-11390990.title: Medium-term clinical results in the treatment of supracondylar humeral fractures in children: does the surgical approach impact outcomes?
pmc-11390990.creator: Elena Manuela Samaila, Ludovica Auregli, Lorenzo Pezzè, Gabriele Colò, Bruno Magnan
pmc-11390990.description: BackgroundRecent literature has found a consensus in favor of conservative treatment for type II supracondylar humeral fractures (SCHF). This retrospective observational study compares the short- to medium-term functional outcomes of conservative versus surgical treatment in 31 patients with SCHF (Gartland II and III) to assess the potential superiority of one approach over the other.

pmc-11489636.title: A cross-sectional analysis of four common clinical decision rules for pulmonary embolism, Mashhad, Iran
pmc-11489636.creator: Solmaz Hassani, Neshat Najaf Najafi, Amirhossein Khodadadi, Fahimeh Gandomi, Mahnaz Amini
pmc-11489636.description: Introduction: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a potentially fatal condition. Several non-invasive clinical decision rules (CDRs) were developed for the safe exclusion of PE. All CDRs used to safely rule out PE have been created and tested within hospital or acute care environments.

pmc-11527789.title: Cloning, bioinformatics analysis and expression of the cysteine dioxygenase type 1 (CDO1) gene in domestic yak
pmc-11527789.creator: Yuxin Fu, Jiuru Yan, Lan Lan, Huizhu Zhang, Peng Wang, Yaying Wang, Xianrong Xiong, Jian Li, Honghong He
pmc-11527789.description: IntroductionThe CDO1 gene is an important gene in the taurine synthesis pathway and has been observed to have high expression in ovaries of female mammals. This study aims to explore the conservation of CDO1 gene in domestic yaks, as well as to examine the fundamental characteristics of CDO1 gene and its expression in female yaks.

pmc-12540594.title: Distribution patterns and origin of potentially toxic elements in soils of the Vanadzor urban area (Armenia)
pmc-12540594.creator: Gevorg Tepanosyan, Tatevik Yenokyan, Zhenya Poghosyan, Astghik Gevorgyan, Lilit Sahakyan
pmc-12540594.description: Urban soils preserve important information about the processes conditioning the pollution levels of urban areas. Thus, geochemical characterization of the urban areas is essential for improving environmental quality and reducing potential risks. The results of this study showed that Cu, Pb, Zn and Cr in soils of Vanadzor city exhibited similar spatial distribution patterns.

pmc-12583775.title: An effective approach to improving photovoltaic defect detection using the new DCD-YOLOv8s model
pmc-12583775.creator: Mohammed Al-Mahbashi, Sara Abdelwahab Ghorashi, Abdolraheem Khader, Sharaf J Malebary, Hafiza Elbadie Ahmed Elsrej, Gang Li, Mohammed Al-Soswa, Akram AL-Radaei
pmc-12583775.description: Photovoltaic (PV) systems play a vital role in the global transition to renewable energy, yet their efficiency is often compromised by surface defects such as dust accumulation, bird droppings, and cracks. Traditional inspection methods are inefficient, while existing deep learning-based detection models struggle with limited adaptability, large model sizes, and inadequate performance under real-world conditions.

pmc-12733482.title: The Learning Curve of Endoscopic Lumbar Interbody Fusion: A Systematic Review
pmc-12733482.creator: Yong Ahn, Hajin An, Sol Lee, Hee Seon Choi, Hye Soo Rho, Adham M Khalafallah, Gregory W Basil
pmc-12733482.description: Background/Objectives: Endoscopic lumbar interbody fusion (ELIF) represents a key milestone in minimally invasive spinal surgery, offering reduced tissue trauma, lower complication rates, and faster recovery compared with open fusion. However, its steep learning curve remains a major barrier to widespread adoption.

pmc-13263881.title: Targeting heterogeneity in atypical epidermal growth factor receptor-mutated non-small cell lung cancer: insights from CHRYSALIS-2
pmc-13263881.creator: Yosuke Dotsu, Hiroshi Mukae
pmc-13263881.description: rom EGFR-targeted therapies, which have been associated with markedly longer survival and better quality of life than was conventional chemotherapy. Current international guidelines, including those from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network and the European Society for Medical Oncology, recommend the use of third-generation EGFR-TKI-based strategies as the preferred first-line treatment for advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC.

pmc-13460172.title: Interpretable machine learning model integrating delta-radiomics enhances postoperative recurrence prediction in early-stage lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-13460172.creator: Feiyang Zhong, Wenping Li, Lijun Wu, Qiaohui Lu, Pengxin Yu, Yuan Fang, Shaohong Zhao

pmc-13516523.title: Detection and Heritability of Genes Conferring Resistance to Potato Pests and Viruses in Hybrid Potato Progeny (Solanum tuberosum L.)
pmc-13516523.creator: Irina V. Kim, Olga A. Sobko, Petr V. Fisenko, Egor M. Shchelkanov, Nadezhda N. Kakareka, Mikhail Yu. Shchelkanov, Aleksei G. Klykov
pmc-13516523.description: Potato viral infections are among the main factors contributing to reduced quality of planting material and decreased tuber productivity. Currently, no reliable chemical control methods are available for plant viral diseases. Therefore, the development of potato cultivars carrying virus resistance genes remains one of the most effective and comprehensive approaches to this problem.

pmc-13539270.title: Sex-Specific Yolk Allocation Revisited: A Test in Starlings and a Review of Evidence in Birds
pmc-13539270.creator: S Casquero, A A Romero-Haro, D Gil, L Pérez-Rodríguez

pmc-13612632.title: The European Society of Pediatric Nephrology Board Examination—a certified benchmark of knowledge and clinical practice with global recognition
pmc-13612632.creator: Ana Teixeira, Stella Stabouli, Rezan Topaloglu, Aysun Karabay Bayazit, Olivia Boyer, Dorota Drozdz, Rukshana Shroff, Martin Christian, Zainab Arslan, Justine Bacchetta, Jerome Harambat, Nikoleta Printza, Louise Oni, Daniella Levy Erez, Caroline Platt, Dieter Haffner, Jun Oh, Elena Levtchenko
pmc-13612632.description: BackgroundSubspecialty recognition and certification in Pediatric Nephrology remain heterogeneous across Europe and globally, resulting in variations in training standards and professional mobility. To address this gap, the European Society for Paediatric Nephrology (ESPN) launched the European Board Certification in 2020 as a pan-European and curriculum-based assessment of knowledge and clinical reasoning in Pediatric Nephrology.

pmc-13641867.title: Predictive Model for Complications in Total Hip Arthroplasty: Development of a Clinical Tool
pmc-13641867.creator: Andrea Moreira Candido, Conrado Torres Laett, Alanna Martins Soares de Palma, Lourenço Pinto Peixoto, Sidnei Cavalcante da Silva
pmc-13641867.description: ObjectiveTo develop a predictive model to estimate complications up to 30 days after total hip arthroplasty (THA), based on clinical and functional variables, aiming at the creation of a practical tool for clinical use.MethodsProspective cohort study conducted in a public referral hospital, with patients undergoing primary and elective THA between November 2021 and April 2022.

pmc-13651127.title: Determinants of modern family planning use among married adolescents in Bangladesh: evidence from a machine learning approach
pmc-13651127.creator: Shawkatul Islam, Md Eyah Eya, Muhammad Khairul Alam
pmc-13651127.description: BackgroundModern family planning (FP) is essential for improving the reproductive health of adolescent women, especially in Bangladesh, where early marriage is still prevalent. Despite overall progress in family planning, modern FP use remains uneven and relatively low among married adolescent women due to social, relational, and contextual barriers.
